name: combo-box
title: Combo Box
description: A searchable multi-select combo box with inline search input and tag display for selected items.

migration.guide: v2 replaces the Select-style button trigger with an inline search input. Breaking changes: (1) Removed `icon` prop — the search icon is now built-in. (2) Removed `searchPlaceholder` — use `placeholder` instead. (3) Removed `allowAdding`/`addMessage` props. (4) Removed `popoverProps` — styling is now built-in. (5) Removed built-in `label`/`required`/`hint` — compose with Label and Hint components externally. (6) Default `tagVariant` changed from 'stroke' to 'gray'. (7) `onValueChange` signature changed to `(values, selectedOptions)` — now passes full option objects as second arg. (8) Added `name` and `defaultValue` props. (9) Ref type changed from HTMLButtonElement to HTMLInputElement. (10) Registry dependency changed from `select` to `input`. (11) Tags render as pills (rounded-full) by default.

docs.lead: A searchable multi-select combo box with inline search. Select from a list of options with search filtering and tag display for selected items. Compose with FormField, Label, and Hint components for form fields.
docs.usage:
import * as ComboBox from "@/components/ui/combo-box"
import * as FormField from "@/components/ui/form-field"
import * as Label from "@/components/ui/label"

<FormField.Root>
  <Label.Root>Sectors</Label.Root>
  <ComboBox.Root
    options={options}
    value={selected}
    onValueChange={setSelected}
    name="sectors"
  />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Basic multi-select combo box with label.
examples.code:
<Label.Root>
  Searchable Combo Box
  <Label.Asterisk />
  <Label.Sub>(Optional)</Label.Sub>
</Label.Root>
<ComboBox.Root
  options={options}
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
/>

examples.title: With Pre-selected Values
examples.description: Combo box with initial selections, useful for editing saved forms.

examples.title: Uncontrolled
examples.description: Use defaultValue for uncontrolled mode in forms.

examples.title: Form Submission
examples.description: Use the name prop to include selected values in form submissions via hidden inputs.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: All three input sizes: medium (default), small, and xsmall.
examples.code:
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} size="small" />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} size="xsmall" />

examples.title: Selection Constraints
examples.description: Limit selections with max, min, or both combined.
examples.code:
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} max={3} />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} min={1} />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} min={1} max={3} />

examples.title: Tag Variants
examples.description: Gray (default), stroke tag style, and selectAllLabel summary tag.
examples.code:
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} tagVariant="gray" />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} tagVariant="stroke" />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={allValues} onValueChange={setValue} selectAllLabel="All tags" />

examples.title: States
examples.code:
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} hasError />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={['grants']} disabled />

examples.title: Customization
examples.description: Custom icon, placeholder text, and empty message.
examples.code:
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} icon={RiMapPinLine} placeholder="Search cities..." />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} placeholder="Type to filter skills..." />
<ComboBox.Root options={options} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} emptyMessage="No matching tags." />

api.name: ComboBox.Root
api.description: The main combo box component. A base component that combines a search input, dropdown list, and tag display for selected items. Compose with Label and Hint components externally for form fields.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when selection changes — receives both raw values and full option objects

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — renders hidden inputs for form submission

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message when no options match the search

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: When provided and all options selected, show a single summary tag

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when dropdown open state changes

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className for the outer wrapper
